precision_and_protocol_observations.observation: Some recorded lead-observed cross spans exceed assigned 90 seconds, and no expiry request preceded those completion notifications. The report explicitly disclaims universal deadline compliance. Exact completion instants and actual compute usage are unavailable.

precision_and_protocol_observations.counterexample: A completed worker may wait in a notification queue past a scheduling boundary; a lead-observed 107-second interval therefore does not prove 107 seconds of worker activity. Conversely, without a timely control event the packet cannot prove an unfinished worker would be stopped at 90 seconds.
precision_and_protocol_observations.minimal_remedy: Retain native completion events when available; if strict deadlines are required, implement a bounded expiry/capture step that includes retention and handoff. Preserve unavailable timings and current disclosures.
precision_and_protocol_observations.fresh_verifier_question: Can the packet establish actual active work beyond a deadline? If only lead-observation bounds exist, preserve UNKNOWN rather than invent a violation.
